newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's forint ends weaker vs dlr at 176.88/93.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's forint ends weaker vs dlr at 176.88/93.

text.p: The Hungarian forint finished the Thursday session of the inter-bank forex market weaker against the dollar as the U.S. unit gained ground against the mark on European markets, dealer said.
The forint ended at 176.88/93 to one dollar, compared with an opening of 176.42/47 and a noon level of 176.50/55.
The forint floats against a currency basket made up 70 percent of the mark and 30 percent of the dollar.
"It was all about the dollar/mark," said Istvan Gere of ING Bank. "It was a rather boring day."
